purpose: Attack the composition layer that would turn the Q0-qualified C3 refinement-certificate checker pair into a production K1 preservation proof kind. P0 itself creates no production authority.

promotion_artifact.representation_rule: Promotion-artifact byte representation is not canonicalized for p: identity. A representation-only reserialization may be a distinct valid artifact only if every outer binding is rebuilt to its new artifact_id.
promotion_artifact.transported_authority_rule: Every field is independently checked against the supplied exact source/profile/certificate/program/artifact and the frozen P0 policy. Self-consistency or a recomputed promotion artifact hash carries no authority.

production_composition_candidate.target_id: must exactly equal independently rederived c2_target_id from the accepted C3 certificate chain
production_composition_candidate.realize: must exactly equal independently rederived projected_realize as a mathematical set
production_composition_candidate.closure_proof_artifact: must equal exact p:sha256 of the supplied promotion artifact bytes
production_composition_candidate.grounding_proofs: exactly one entry per REALIZE pair, each pair unique, every proof.kind k1.mediated-refinement/v1 and proof.artifact equal the same promotion artifact_id

checker_composition_rule: P0 promotion checker must strict-parse promotion artifact and outer W0 certificate with duplicate-key rejection and exact top-level key sets.

P0 must verify all proof-kind, source-semantics, downstream-kind, authority-scope, Q0-anchor, candidate-id, W10-blob and W11-blob pins against this frozen policy; these values are not caller-selectable authority.
P0 must bind exact bytes of profile, C3 certificate, C2 program and C2 artifact to the promotion artifact before invoking semantic checkers.

Both Q0-qualified checkers W10 A1 and W11 must ACCEPT the same exact source/certificate/program/artifact inputs and agree on certificate_id, C2 certificate_id, source_id, ordered trace id, target_id and REALIZE pair count.
One-checker success, checker disagreement, checker absence, malformed checker output or unexpected checker identity fails closed.
Only after dual Q0 acceptance may P0 construct/compare the expected outer W0 preservation certificate. The outer certificate can never repair or override a failed inner C3 chain.
Unknown or older proof kinds, qualification anchors or checker candidates are unsupported and cannot be silently downgraded to C2 or W0 generic authority.

forbidden_repairs: Do not change a frozen attack oracle after a candidate promotion checker fails it.
Do not treat a self-consistent outer W0 certificate as evidence that the inner C3 refinement chain was valid.
Do not infer native-program authority, broader source semantics, broader downstream proof kinds, or future qualification candidates from this exact MFST A1 qualification.
Do not modify Q0-qualified W10/W11, W7/W8, W5/W6, C2 semantics, or K1 W0 identity rules to make P0 pass.
success_rule: Both independently implemented P0 promotion checkers pass all 8 positives and reject/fail-closed all 44 negatives.
The P0 checkers independently reconstruct the promotion artifact identity, Q0 policy pins, evidence root, expected W0 certificate composition and existing W0 certificate_id.
The Q0 A1 checker blobs remain exact and unchanged.
P0 remains non-authoritative until a later promotion decision explicitly changes production proof-kind policy.
